newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Ericsson down after Nokia report.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson down after Nokia report.

text.p: Shares in Swedish telecoms group Ericsson fell further on Monday after Finnish rival Nokia reported strong earnings for the first half of the year.
At 1330 GMT, Ericsson was changing hands at 353.5 crowns, down eight but off an intra-day low of 352.
"Nokia said it is taking market share on the mobile systems side, which some players might be interpreting to mean that it has taken some from Ericsson (which is strong on systems)," a broker said.
"Also, many players could have been too long in Nokia and Ericsson."
Other dealers said Ericsson was merely seeing profit taking after falling in New York on Friday.

Nokia said a record second-quarter helped its first-half profit surge to 3.33 billion markka, and said it had reason to maintain an outlook for good full-year profitability. The profit beat analysts expectations of three billion markka.
